info.title: API.SH: Coinbase
info.description: The Coinbase API from API.SH: public Coinbase data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Price candles (open, high, low, close, volume) of a Coinbase Exchange pair, oldest first, up to 300 a call. Without dates you get the latest 300. To page back, pass `next_end` as `end`; null when there is no earlier page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-candles

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Candle size: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h or 1d (default), or the same in seconds.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start time, ISO date or unix time.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End time, ISO date or unix time.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The currencies Coinbase lists: crypto assets (code, name, asset id, decimals, color, address format) or fiat currencies (code, name, minimum size); `q` filters by code or name.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-currencies

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Code or name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Exchange rates from one currency to every other fiat and crypto currency Coinbase knows (how many units of each per one unit of `currency`); `symbols` keeps only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-exchange-rates

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
24-hour stats of every Coinbase Exchange pair in one quote currency, ranked: price, open, high, low, change percent, base and quote volume and 30-day volume. Sort by change for gainers and losers, or by volume.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-movers

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Coinbase Exchange pair's order book: bids and asks with price, size and order count per level, best bid and ask and the spread.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-orderbook

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Price levels per side, 1-1000 (default 50; 1 gives the best bid and ask only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every trading pair on Coinbase Exchange with its status, base and quote currency, price and size increments, minimum order funds and trading flags (post-only, limit-only, cancel-only, auction mode, margin). Filter by quote or base currency, status or part of the pair id. With `currency`, the response also carries a `currency` object for that asset: name, type, symbol, status, minimum size and precision, withdrawal limits, confirmations, default network and every supported network (status, contract address, withdrawal limits, confirmations, explorer links).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-products

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Only pairs quoted in this currency (USD, USDC, EUR, GBP, BTC ...).

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Only pairs of this base currency (BTC, ETH ...).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only pair ids containing this text.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Also return this asset's details (BTC, ETH, USDC, USD ...) in `currency`: name, precision, networks, withdrawal limits and status. Unknown codes answer 404.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Coinbase spot, buy and sell price
get.description:
Coinbase's consumer price for a pair: spot, buy and sell price with the spread, or the spot price on a past `date`. With a single currency code as `pair` (e.g. USD), the spot price of every asset Coinbase prices in it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-spot-price

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: A pair such as BTC-USD, or one currency code (USD) for every asset.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A past date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the historical spot price.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: With a currency code as pair: only this asset.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Coinbase Exchange pair's last price, best bid and ask, last trade, 24-hour open, high, low, change and volume, 30-day volume and the pair's trading rules.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-ticker

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Trading pair as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-EUR, SOL-USDC.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Coinbase's server time (ISO and epoch seconds) and the difference to this server's clock.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-time

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Coinbase Exchange pair's latest trades, newest first: trade id, time, taker side, price and size. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for older trades; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinbase-trades

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
